exclusion_detail: Lead 7g needs 7 reactions from commercial materials, all with procedures: (1) esterification of 2-aminonicotinic acid, (2) LiAlH4 reduction to (2-aminopyridin-3-yl)methanol, (3) CuBr2 bromination of 2,4-dichloroacetophenone, (4) cyclisation of 2 with the bromoketone to the imidazopyridine methanol 4g, (5) 3,6-dichloropyridazine + semicarbazide to the triazolopyridazinone 5, (6) POCl3 to 6, (7) NaH coupling of 4g with 6 to give 7g.

lead.label: 7g
lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 7g exhibited the most inhibitory activity against c-Met with IC50 of 53.4 nM and 253 nM in enzymatic and cellular level'.

notes: Every compound 7a-7j shares the same two branches (4 steps for the imidazopyridine, 2 for the chlorotriazolopyridazine, plus the coupling), so all are 7 steps. No SI in the bundle (accepted manuscript; not needed).
